description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a single filter narrows the product list to matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed with at least one filter available, and <a filter value that matches some but not all products in the list> is known.
steps: Open the product list and note the products shown before filtering.
Apply the filter <a filter value that matches some but not all products in the list>.
Review the product list after the filter is applied.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed: only products matching the applied filter value are shown, and products that do not match are no longer listed.

cases.title: Applying more than one filter narrows the list to products matching all of them
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed with at least two filters available, and <two filter values that together match at least one product> are known.
steps: Apply the first filter <filter value 1> and note the resulting list.
Apply the second filter <filter value 2> without removing the first one.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed further: only products matching both applied filter values are shown; products matching only one of the two are no longer listed.

cases.title: Removing an applied filter restores the products that were filtered out
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed and <a filter value that matches some but not all products in the list> is known.
steps: Open the product list and note the products shown before filtering.
Apply the filter <a filter value that matches some but not all products in the list>.
cases.expected: The list returns to showing the products that were listed before the filter was applied.

cases.title: Applying a filter that matches no products
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed and <a filter value that matches no product in the list> is known.
steps: Apply the filter <a filter value that matches no product in the list>.
cases.expected: No products are shown, since none match the applied filter. The exact message or empty-state shown is not specified in the story.
